title: FAA seeks to fine Boeing $3.1 million for safety violations, door plug blowout
summary: The FAA said it identified hundreds of quality system violations at Boeing's 737 factory in Renton, Wash., and Boeing subcontractor Spirit AeroSystems' 737 factory in Wichita, Kan.

title: Megachurch leader and his mother indicted on sex trafficking and racketeering charges
summary: Prosecutors claim the family that has long led La Luz del Mundo — or Light of the World — church committed sexual abuse across generations. An accuser compares the church leadership to the mafia.
